about.title: About
about.bio: Amateur photographer passionate about capturing beauty in everyday moments and extraordinary occasions. My approach combines technical expertise with artistic vision to create images that tell captivating stories and evoke genuine emotions. Each photograph is crafted with attention to detail and a deep understanding of light, composition, and human connection.
